BOT_TOKEN.description: Your bot token, as a string.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Secret key for Fernet credential encryption. Generate via: python -c 'from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())'

DATABASE_URL.description: Standard Postgres database connection URI (optional, auto-supplied by Heroku Postgres).

POSTGRES_USER_ID.description: Postgres User ID (used if DATABASE_URL is not set).

ENABLE_MCP_SERVER.description: Set to 'true' to automatically launch the IARE-BOT MCP server with main.py

MCP_PASSWORD.description: Secret password protecting MCP server endpoints against unauthorized access
